kdwe01.title: Scorpio's Unbothered Timer
kdwe01.caption:
Replied in one second. Scheduled it for two hours later.
The mystery is a timer, and the timer is for Scorpio. Who in your group chat runs on a send delay?

kdwe02.title: Virgo's Off-Camera Room
kdwe02.caption:
The spotless corner is real. So is the sock on the lamp.
First-date Virgo and Tuesday Virgo live in the same room. Which one answers your video calls?

kdwe03.title: Leo Rehearses Being Casual
kdwe03.caption:
Thirty takes of "oh, didn't see you there" to a cardboard crush.
Then the real one walks in and Leo forgets every line. Tag the friend who practises small talk.

kdwe04.title: Cancer's Hoodie Box
kdwe04.caption:
The box says DONATE. The box has said DONATE for a while.
Moving on is real, the hoodie just has a longer timeline. What's still in your box?

kdwe05.title: Gemini's Three Group Chats
kdwe05.caption:
It's nothing. We're basically dating. Who?
Same crush, three group chats, three completely different stories. One "hey" and all of them find out. Which chat gets the real version?

kdwe06.title: Taurus Sets Two Plates
kdwe06.caption:
Single and loving it. Also: two plates, two napkins, two candles.
Just in case. Taurus is very prepared for a dinner nobody's planned yet. Who sets the table for two in your group?

kdwe07.title: Libra's Secret Ranked List
kdwe07.caption:
"Anywhere's fine" has a ranked list, a backup plan and a backup for the backup.
Number one was always the noodle place. What's your secret number one?

kdwe08.title: Sagittarius Saves the Voice Notes
kdwe08.caption:
"I don't catch feelings" says the sign with a folder of starred voice notes.
The 2 a.m. replay is a free spirit's love language. Who's saving yours?

kdwe09.title: Capricorn's Calendar Block
kdwe09.caption:
Too busy to date. Every day, 3:00 to 3:15, one block is pink.
Capricorn scheduled the feelings and declined the meeting that tried to move them. Which sign protects your slot?

kdwe10.title: Aquarius Rewinds the Proposal
kdwe10.caption:
Romance is a social construct, says Aquarius, rewinding the proposal scene for the second time.
Detached until the loading bar hits error. Who in your life cries at films and denies it?

kdwe11.title: Aries Waits for a Reply
kdwe11.caption:
"I don't wait for texts." Every push-up is also a phone check.
Patience bar empty, reply lands, Aries leaves the floor. Which sign is your fastest refresher?

kdwe12.title: Pisces' Tear Bucket System
kdwe12.caption:
Pisces barely cries. There are four labelled buckets and a backup.
One kind text and the system overflows, happy tears only. Who would need the dog-in-a-scarf bucket?

kdwe13.title: Virgo Ignores Its Own Advice
kdwe13.caption:
Perfect advice for everyone else. Its own text to its crush: drafted, saved, 41 days old.
The friend who gives advice finally took it. Tag the one who needs to hit send.

kdwe14.title: Aries Preps for the Family Dinner
kdwe14.caption:
Three rehearsed answers for "so, are you seeing anyone?"
Then the aunt asks about the job. Every holiday dinner has this moment. What's your prepared line?

kdwe15.title: Sagittarius Plans Spontaneity
kdwe15.caption:
"Let's just go somewhere, spontaneously!" Three months of planning, laminated, with tabs.
The crush said yes and Sagittarius fainted. Which sign plans the surprise down to the snack stop?

kdwe16.title: Everything Cancer Hides
kdwe16.caption:
Five things Cancer would never show you, and number five is the one that stings.
The friend who checks on everyone needs a check-in too. Who's going to call yours today?

kdwe17.title: Everything Libra Hides
kdwe17.caption:
Libra lost an argument to its own reflection, and that's only secret one.
Four drafts of hey, two plans in one night, a tied poll, and a heart that already knows. Which secret is most you?

kdwe18.title: Everything Aquarius Hides
kdwe18.caption:
Aquarius keeps five classified files. The last one is the softest thing you'll see today.
Aloof in public, accepting hugs in private. Who's your Aquarius?

kdwe19.title: Everything Taurus Hides
kdwe19.caption:
Taurus has had a sticky note in its pocket for six months. That's secret five.
Before that: the sweater, the comfort film, the map standoff and the fries. Slow isn't the same as unsure.

kdwe20.title: Everything Gemini Hides
kdwe20.caption:
Gemini argues with itself, quits hobbies weekly and panics at "Seen".
Wait for secret five, because Gemini remembers everything you ever told it. Who remembers your coffee order?
